title: Cattle mutilations done by humans

tellings.quote: Same thing with cattle mutilations. Linda Moon thinks those are aliens. No, we're doing that.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor and well-known UFO campaigner, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that the cattle mutilations, cases where farm animals are found dead and strangely cut, are done by people, not aliens. He says the journalist Linda Moulton Howe thinks aliens are behind them, but in his words, "we're doing that", meaning humans are staging what gets blamed on visitors.
